capabilities.label: Editable JianYing revision contract
capabilities.description: Preserves source media, separated audio, visible cuts, exact review markers, and final acceptance gates.

actual_result.summary: The editable-draft source and acceptance contracts are bundled.

capabilities.label: 16 repository-local Auto-Cut skills
capabilities.description: Installs repository skills locally and verifies every installed file against the bundled source tree.

actual_result.summary: Sixteen source skill trees are bundled for target-local installation.

capabilities.label: Main Python dependencies
capabilities.description: Creates the main .venv and installs requirements.txt either online or from the verified Windows x64 CPython 3.11 offline companion.

actual_result.summary: Packages and their import probe run on the target computer; offline mode is fail-closed and uses only the verified wheelhouse.

capabilities.label: Playwright Chromium
capabilities.description: Installs pinned Playwright 1.52.0 Chromium revision 1169, recording FFmpeg revision 1011, and WinLDD revision 1007 under MIT and Apache-2.0 terms; persists the browser store at tmp/offline-runtime/browsers; and performs a real headless launch plus record_video_dir artifact probe.

actual_result.summary: Chromium launch and record_video_dir output are verified on the target computer through the persisted browser store; offline mode performs no browser download.

capabilities.label: JianYing editable-draft smoke test
capabilities.description: Detects the local JianYing installation, writes an editable smoke draft, and requests cleanup.

actual_result.summary: Readiness depends on a compatible JianYing installation on the target computer.

capabilities.label: Favorite flower-text and text-template assets
capabilities.description: Rebuilds indexes from the target user's own JianYing favorites and local caches.

actual_result.summary: Target-local favorite assets are never copied from the build computer.

capabilities.label: Subject pointer profiles
capabilities.description: Uses explicit stage and subject identity, pointer PNGs, scale screenshots, approved previews, optional private-profile migration into a new empty isolated registry, and separate binding confirmation.

actual_result.summary: Each target user must create a profile or restore the private profile into a new empty isolated registry, check and validate it, and explicitly bind the exact target project.

capabilities.label: Optional Feishu user-action notifications
capabilities.description: Sends notification-only alerts after local setup; all decisions remain in the originating Codex task.

actual_result.summary: Configuration, authorization, recipient approval, and setup preview are target-local.

capabilities.label: FFmpeg
capabilities.description: Uses the committed, reproducibly built minimal FFmpeg 8.1.2 (source tag n8.1.2; static Windows x64 binaries with no external codec libraries) from the verified offline companion, persisted at tmp/offline-runtime/tools/ffmpeg, or a separately verified target-local executable.

actual_result.summary: Formal offline setup installs and auto-discovers the fixed licensed companion copy; online setup otherwise requires a target-local executable.

capabilities.label: FFprobe
capabilities.description: Uses the committed, reproducibly built minimal FFprobe 8.1.2 (source tag n8.1.2; static Windows x64 binaries with no external codec libraries) from the verified offline companion, persisted at tmp/offline-runtime/tools/ffmpeg, or a separately verified target-local executable.

actual_result.summary: Formal offline setup installs and auto-discovers the fixed licensed companion copy; online setup otherwise requires a target-local executable.

capabilities.label: Isolated audio runtime
capabilities.description: Creates .venv-audio with Python 3.11 and the dedicated locked audio dependency set, using only the verified audio wheelhouse in offline mode.

actual_result.summary: The isolated runtime and doctor execute on the target computer.

capabilities.label: SpectraMini-style local cleanup
capabilities.description: Uses the maintained local breath and mouth-click stages after the isolated audio environment is installed.

actual_result.summary: Availability is reported only after the real target-machine audio doctor runs.

capabilities.label: DeepFilterNet model-backed cleanup
capabilities.description: May cache and install the declared wheel, but remains disabled until a licensed, fixed, hash-verified model and trusted adapter are available.

actual_result.summary: Package presence alone is insufficient; no verified model and adapter identity is bundled.

capabilities.label: Respiro model-backed cleanup
capabilities.description: Remains disabled until licensed, fixed, hash-verified assets and a trusted runtime adapter are available.

actual_result.summary: No verified model manifest or trusted runtime adapter is bundled.

capabilities.label: Volcengine word-level ASR alignment
capabilities.description: Bundles the maintained alignment adapter while requiring each target user to provide and verify their own Volcengine authorization.

actual_result.summary: The adapter is bundled; authorization and the real service probe are target-local.

capabilities.label: Target-local JianYing SAMI voice generation
capabilities.description: Uses only the target computer's own JianYing identity with verified TLS and never bundles or reports device identifiers.

actual_result.summary: Availability depends on target-local JianYing identity and a successful network request.

capabilities.label: Edge TTS network fallback
capabilities.description: Installs the pinned Edge TTS client with main dependencies and reports network execution separately from import readiness.

actual_result.summary: The client is installed on first use; a network voice request remains target-dependent.

capabilities.label: Validated cloud material acquisition
capabilities.description: Bundles static material indexes and downloads validated remote assets only into the target package's temporary cache.

actual_result.summary: The static index is bundled; individual remote URLs are validated only when requested.

capabilities.label: Subtitle-to-material matching
capabilities.description: Provides deterministic matching and reports that no attributable external AI matching provider is currently bundled.

actual_result.summary: Deterministic round-robin matching is bundled; external AI matching is not claimed.

capabilities.label: Optional Carnac key overlay
capabilities.description: Detects a target-installed or explicitly configured Carnac executable without downloading an unverified binary.

actual_result.summary: Carnac is optional target software; recording remains available without it.
